scripts.name: inflate_1.0
scripts.description: Inflate — give a flat vector shape the look of an inflated pillow, in one step, without adding nodes. Grows each shape by the room inside it rather than by a constant, so a fat body swells while a thin arm barely moves, edges bow between pinched corners, and counters close as they would on a real puffy letter. Node count and node order are preserved, so the result is still editable as the shape you drew. Two settings: how much to inflate, and how much to round sharp points.
scripts.author: olliollio
